messages:
Nora: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: three vendor-related incidents in two weeks. Goal: assign owners for short remediations and a verification step.
Maya: agree. summary of failure chain?
Nora: Auth provider rate-limit spikes -> model-registry returns 429/401 -> client retries and sticky routing prevents cross-region failover.
Liam: I can own vendor comms and SLA ask. Will open SR.
Arjun: I'll own client fixes: split 401 vs 429 handling and add jittered backoff. ETA 3 business days.
Tess: I'll own routing change: lower sticky TTL to 30s for model traffic and add a canary. ETA 5 business days.
Maya: Infra synthetic test to detect retry storms?
infra-bot: Creating synthetic job template: "auth-429-burst-test". Will run daily in staging.
Nora: Action list:
- A1: Arjun -> client PR + tests (due: 3 business days)
- A2: Liam -> open SR + request maintenance windows (due: 7 business days)
- A3: Tess -> routing TTL canary plan (due: 5 business days)
- A4: infra-bot -> synthetic job + alert (due: 2 business days)
Maya: Scheduling 48h check-in to confirm progress. Keep updates in the postmortem doc, not here.
Liam: SR opened: SR-66011. Posting updates in the follow-up doc.
Arjun: Will post PR link when ready.
Tess: Will prepare canary roll plan and rollback criteria.
Nora: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; see postmortem follow-up doc for tracking.
